body:
Open Thursday, November 19th through Sunday, December 27th

The 16O9 Restaurant has been transformed into the ultimate festive winter wonderland.

The chilly weather is perfect for sipping hot buttered rum cocktails or warm apple cider outside enjoying ocean scenery and getting cozy under warm blankets. There's also a section of festive foods that include warm soups, gourmet cheese toasties, and decadent fondue dippers. Enjoy live entertainment while toasting the holiday spirit and snuggling around a fire.

Thursday to Sunday from Nov 19th - Dec 27th | 2pm - 10pm
Location: 16O9 Bar & Restaurant at Hamilton Princess & Beach Club
field_recurrence: Recurring weekly on Sunday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday
title: Frostbite Lounge-A Festive Wonderland
